notes.title: 06.19.25 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This patch applies only to the English, French, German, and Japanese versions of the game. 
This patch is associated with the following revision numbers for each game within the collection:

LUNAR Silver Star Complete - REV:8352

LUNAR 2 Eternal Blue - REV:8350

The revision number can be confirmed by putting either game into windowed mode and checking the number displayed at the top of the window.


Patch Notes:


LUNAR Silver Star Story

Fixed an issue where a phrase used in the game’s dialogue text wouldn’t display correctly.*

Fixed several errors in the dialogue where information was incorrect/contained spoilers for future events.*

Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck inside an NPC if they entered a room at a specific timing.

Fixed a graphical issue where a normally off-screen area could be displayed at the top of Myght’s Tower.

LUNAR 2 Eternal Blue

Fixed an issue where the icons used for certain Magic were different than the original.

Fixed an issue where text for some of the books in Gwyn's House would be displayed off-center.*

Fixed the item description for Gauss’ Necklace, which incorrectly indicated it would restore 7 HP instead of 1.*

Improved the FPS performance of LUNAR 2 Eternal Blue.



*Indicates an issue was only present in the English, French, and German versions of the game.

notes.title: English Audio Update
notes.notes:
Update:

The issue where each game in the collection defaulted to Japanese audio, even when English text was selected from the launcher, has now been fixed.
